name: UNIHIKER Single Board Computer
fullName: UNIHIKER IoT Single Board Computer with 2.8-inch Color Touchscreen
tagline: Linux-based single board computer with touchscreen, light sensor, accelerometer, and microphone
description: UNIHIKER is a single-board computer that brings you brand new experience for learning and coding in Python. Built with a 2.8-inch color touchscreen, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, light sensor, accelerometer, gyroscope, microphone, and co-processor (GD32VF103), it can run desktop Python libraries directly while interfacing with physical pins.

specs.onboardSensors: Light Sensor, 6-Axis IMU (Accelerometer & Gyroscope), Microphone, Buzzer
specs.expansion: Edge connector (compatible with micro:bit ecosystem), Gravity 3-pin & 4-pin ports

pinout.name: Power & Programming
pinout.desc: 5V 2A power input and virtual network programming interface (http://10.1.2.3)

pinout.name: Edge Connector Pins
pinout.desc: GPIO, ADC, PWM, I2C, SPI expansion pins

wiringNote: Plug in via USB-C to PC and connect to web IDE at http://10.1.2.3 or via VS Code Remote SSH.
codeSnippet:
from unihiker import GUI
import time
gui = GUI()
gui.draw_text(x=120, y=100, text='Hello UNIHIKER!', origin='center', color='blue')

commonMistakes: Underpowering from low-current USB ports (requires minimum 5V 1.5A supply)
